_help: Recurring programmes shown on the Opening radar. 'auto' programmes are matched against listings from their source; 'manual' ones are checked by you. Add real evidence only, always with a source URL: evidence = [{"cycle": 2026, "openedOn": "2025-09-15", "deadline": null, "sourceUrl": "https://...", "note": "..."}]. When an employer announces dates, fill 'announced': {"cycle": 2027, "opening": "YYYY-MM-DD", "deadline": "YYYY-MM-DD", "sourceUrl": "https://...", "verifiedOn": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Radar also records openings it observes itself, so predictions improve each year.
